notes: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 reached GA on 2026-08-13 and is exposed through the deepseek-v4-pro API model ID.
DeepSeek currently lists deepseek-v4-pro as an active API model; no retirement date is recorded in this profile because the checked current primary documentation does not declare one.
The model has a 1,000,000-token context window and a maximum 384,000-token output.
Thinking and non-thinking modes are supported. reasoning_effort supports low, high, and max; high is the documented default.
In thinking mode, temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, and frequency_penalty are accepted for compatibility but documented as having no effect.
JSON Output and JSON-schema response formatting are supported.
The Responses API supports server-side web_search and the apply_patch custom tool.

Responses API file_search, code_interpreter, computer_use, MCP, and other unsupported built-in tool types are ignored; CKB therefore records built-in code execution, computer use, and MCP as unsupported for this provider/model surface.
Native OpenAI Responses API, OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible API, and Anthropic-compatible API surfaces are supported.
No knowledge cutoff is declared in the checked primary documentation.
